title: Northrop B-35 flying wing bomber in flight, air-to-air view (Fig. 6)
description: Air-to-air photograph of the Northrop B-35 flying wing with its four pusher propellers, flying above a cloud layer, with the engine nacelle of the camera aircraft in the lower right foreground. Labelled "Fig. 6" in the margin with an "A.C." photo number at lower right. Included as an example of US flying wing designs.
